steps.what: Show the cost figures already stored for this design.
Provide advice on project costs, design concepts, or design changes.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} record shows cost figures already stored for the design. The systems engineer provides advice on the project costs, the design concepts, or the design changes. The figure is not the advice. A design with no stored figure is discussed without an invented number.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice quoted a cost from a different design because this one's figure was not opened.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored cost figures can be shown. The advice still comes from the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A design change the figures do not cover has to be talked through.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer gives the advice. A stored figure is not that advice.
tasks.altitude: Advice on cost and design stays with the engineer. The stored figure is visible and is not the recommendation.

reach.task: Check a cost figure the engineer will advise on.
reach.learn: A stored figure is not the advice.

evidence.claim: Showing stored cost figures is a lookup. It does not provide advice on the design.
A missing figure is not replaced with one from another design. The engineer gives the advice.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The design id and cost figures already stored for it. A blank figure is not calculated from a different design. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the project cost record before the advice conversation.
unknowns: Whether design-concept notes and cost figures sit on the same project record.
research_questions: Who else must hear the advice before a design change is funded?

already_counted.description: Advising on costs, concepts, and design changes stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop cost figures for designs that have been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still advises on project costs, design concepts, or design changes. Only showing cost figures already stored is removed. A design with no stored figure saves none of the advice, and no figure is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored cost, portability, compatibility, and usability factors.
Evaluate current or emerging technologies using those stored factors.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows cost, portability, compatibility, and usability factors already stored. The systems engineer evaluates the current or emerging technology. A factor that is missing stops the comparison, and the engineer does not rank a technology the record does not cover. The factors are not the evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: A technology was ranked from a vendor paragraph because the factor record was incomplete.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored factors can be shown. Evaluating the technology still takes the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: An emerging technology with no stored usability note cannot be ranked from the other factors alone.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer evaluates the technology. The factor table is not a ranking.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation stays with the engineer. Stored factors are visible and do not rank the technology.

reach.task: Use an evaluation the engineer has written.
reach.learn: A factor table is not the evaluation.

evidence.claim: Showing stored factors is a lookup. It does not evaluate the technology or rank it.
A missing factor stops the comparison. The engineer does not treat a gap as a score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The technology id and the factors already stored. A missing factor is not scored as zero. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the factor record in the document store before the evaluation.
unknowns: Whether current and emerging technologies share one factor record.
research_questions: Who supplies a factor when the record is blank and the engineer has not seen the technology?

already_counted.description: Evaluating the technology stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop factor rows for technologies that are no longer candidates.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still evaluates the current or emerging technology. Only showing factors already stored is removed. A missing factor saves nothing, is not scored as zero, and does not produce a rank.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the project plan, schedule, and budget lines already drafted.
Develop or approve the project plans, schedules, or budgets.
File the accepted project plan, schedule, and budget.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} record shows plan, schedule, and budget lines already drafted. The systems engineer develops or approves them and accepts that version. Only the accepted plan is filed. A line that is blank is not approved. The screen does not approve the budget.
tasks.previous_blocker: A budget was filed from the draft because the approval was a verbal yes with no version.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafted lines can be shown. Developing or approving them still takes the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A schedule that fits the lines and not the people doing the work is refused by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops or approves the plan. Filing stores the version that was accepted.
tasks.altitude: Approval of the plan, the schedule, and the budget stays with the engineer. The file holds only that version.

reach.task: Work to a plan the engineer has approved.
reach.learn: A drafted line is not the approval.

evidence.claim: Showing drafted plan lines is a lookup. It does not approve the plan, the schedule, or the budget.
The engineer approves a version. Filing stores that version and does not approve a later edit.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The plan id and lines already drafted. A blank budget line is not approved as zero. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the project plan before the approval conversation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether schedules and budgets are approved on the same version as the plan.
research_questions: Who else must approve a budget above the engineer's own limit?

already_counted.description: Developing or approving the plan, schedule, and budget stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop filed plans whose drafted lines have been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: plan version and the line ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops or approves the plan, the schedule, or the budget. Only showing lines already drafted, and filing the version already accepted, is removed. A blank line is not approved as zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Draft report sentences only when the held project note states them.

loop.input: a page id and one sentence from that page
loop.output: a sentence kept only when that page states it
loop.check: The sentence cites a page id and the page text contains it.
loop.stop: Stop when there is no page id, or the page does not state the sentence. The engineer writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed report skeleton cannot tell which sentence the project note does not state, so it would present a claim the note does not make.

steps.what: Communicate project information in the technical report or white paper, and accept it.
File the accepted technical report or white paper.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store drafts a report sentence only when the held project note states it. The systems engineer writes the technical report or the white paper, communicates the project information, and accepts the text. Only that version is filed for the project. The machine does not send it. A claim the note does not state is written by the engineer or left out.
tasks.previous_blocker: A white paper repeated numbers from a different project because the note was not opened.
tasks.enabler_now: A held project note can supply a sentence it states. The paper still has to be written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Presenting the paper to an audience, and refusing a claim the note does not support, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer writes and accepts the paper. A quoted sentence is not the communication.
tasks.altitude: The report and the presentation stay with the engineer. The file holds the accepted text and does not send it.

reach.task: Publish only a paper the engineer has accepted, if publication is even asked.
reach.learn: A draft sentence is not the paper.

evidence.claim: A sentence may be kept only when the held project note states it. The draft is not the report.
The engineer communicates the project information and accepts the text. The file does not send the paper.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The project-note id and a sentence that note states. A number with no note is not kept. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the project note in the document store before drafting.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether technical reports and white papers use the same note as their source.
research_questions: Who may present the paper when the engineer has accepted the text but will not be in the room?

already_counted.description: Writing the paper, communicating it, and accepting the text stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop papers whose project note has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: paper version and the project note ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still writes the technical report or white paper, still communicates the project information, and still accepts the text. The draft may repeat only a sentence the held note states. Only that accepted version is filed, and it is not sent. A claim the note does not state saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The systems engineer still advises on cost, still evaluates a technology, and still approves the plan. A stored figure or a stored factor can be opened. It does not give the advice or the approval.
reach: Operations research analysts compare factors, and this job learns a stored factor is not the evaluation.
Software developers write the report's subject, and this job learns the engineer still accepts the paper.
skills_to_grow: Advise from the figures, and say when a figure is missing rather than inventing one.
Evaluate a technology on the factors already stored, and do not rank one the record does not cover.
Approve the plan, the schedule, or the budget, and file only that accepted version.
role.ambitious_version: Advice, technology evaluation, plan approval, and the project paper stay with the engineer. Stored figures and notes only show what was already recorded.
